title: The Earnings Announcement Premium Around the Globe
one_line: Across 46 markets (1991-2010) a long-announcers / short-non-announcers portfolio earned 7.16%/yr with a 40% higher Sharpe than the market; the premium tracks the rise in idiosyncratic uncertainty around announcements.

findings.statement: 7.16%/yr raw; significant in 9 of the 20 biggest countries (63-236 bps).
Driven by uncertainty about the disclosure, not attention or limits to arbitrage.
